audit_findings.evidence: Bridge.run shields a single child-owning task, sends its cancellation at most once, drains repeated consumer cancellation until the task finishes, and retrieves its terminal exception. Speech retains shared flock inside ASR quiescence and local slot until run returns/raises. Real harmless SIGTERM-ignoring child test forces terminate timeout/kill/reap across repeated cancellation; shared lock remains denied and ASR resumes only after returncode is set and PID is absent. Success, safe native failure, output overflow and timeout paths also pass.

Production and evaluation use AdmissionCoordinator same persistent nonblocking exclusive flock. Canonical evaluation default is /root/voice-lab/.runtime/live-tts.lock; explicit environment can align both. Production subclass deliberately disables evaluation production detection, avoiding false contention from quiesced ASR. Absolute/no-traversal/no-symlink path, O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/O_CLOEXEC, regular file/euid/mode0600/nlink1 and post-flock device/inode equality enforced; never unlink. Unsafe paths/types/modes/links and cross-process contention tested.

Bridge uses bounded regular-file pinned reader at construction and every check/tts argv construction. Missing, drifted and symlink worker tests reject before spawn. Readiness invokes explicitly selected cloned worker with quality12 for all seven enabled B profiles, fails on first rejection, and does not silently test legacy worker. Worker separately checks verifier digest, manifest digest and native guard/live/SDK source inventory before imports.

VOICE_SELA_LIVE_TTS accepts only strings 0/1, defaults off; enabled requires supertonic3 plus conditioning_b and explicit installed interpreter/worker/digest/lock. Disabled path preserves original argv/identity. Native failure metadata survives once with no retry/fallback. Legacy local STT/ASR path remains unchanged.

Chunk source partition/pronunciation/immutable per-response conditioning snapshot, boundary trimming and final flags remain unchanged from production. Server queues original source span, registers ACK before emission, prefetches at most one successor, requires matching ACK, and cancels/drains prefetch before stream close. Session appends original span to heard_text only on matching token/chunk ACK. Integration and server regressions pass for complete text, partial failure, interruption and repeated cancellation.

Production bridge fixes argv steps to 12, no environment step/seed/speed override added. Exact guarded profile allowlist follows worker prefix precheck; immutable B and six app-relative routed profile pins unchanged. Guard seeds numpy with 20261026 and preserves speed1.05/default silence unless separately enabled existing experimental controls. Step context overrides only original total_steps=8 to12 and restores method. Native PCM, resource, offline and seccomp controls preserved byte-for-byte.

Stage manifest intentionally references staging guard/live and external clone; it must not be deployed untransformed. Builder actual-source plan validates pinned vendor provenance/license/inventory, changes only three roots to /root/voice-lab/{voice_app,sela_live_tts,vendor/supertonic} and the worker MANIFEST_SHA literal, binds supplied reviewed source worker digest and writes nothing in plan mode. Model/runtime dependencies under /root/voice-lab/autonomous/expressive-tts are pre-existing durable dependencies, not disposable paths. Parent must use transformed worker SHA, not source SHA.

limitations: No native/model inference performed. Tests use mocked native calls, harmless Python subprocess fixtures, offline source/dependency inspection and fixture ffmpeg conversion. Full discovery intentionally not run because historical ungated native tests exist.
